newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan imported car sales plunge for second month.
newsitem.headline: Japan imported car sales plunge for second month.

text.p: Imported car sales in Japan fell sharply in May for the second consecutive month, depressed by April's sales tax increase, and the downtrend is expected to continue for at least another month, an industry body said Thursday.

The Japan Automobile Importers Association said imported vehicles sold in Japan in May fell 27 percent from a year earlier to 22,919 units. In April, imported car sales slipped nearly 37 percent to 20,869 units.
Consumers continued to keep their distance from big-ticket items like cars following a rise in the national sales tax to 5 percent from 3 percent April 1.
A decrease in the number of cars made abroad by Japanese carmakers and an increase in the price of some foreign car models in April also contributed to the drop, the association said.
Sales in Japan of vehicles produced by overseas units of Japanese carmakers fell by 58 percent to 2,517 in May.
